settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings(["mode", "level"], ["slow", "5"]) == ["slow", "5"]
  ex settings(["color"], ["red"]) == ["fast", "3", "red"]
  ex settings(["level", "mode"], ["5", "slow"]) == ["slow", "5"]
  var mode_v = "fast"
  var level_v = "3"
  var rest: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    if keys[i] == "mode"
      mode_v = copy values[i]
    else if keys[i] == "level"
      level_v = copy values[i]
    else
      rest = rest + [copy values[i]]
  [copy mode_v, copy level_v] + rest

test_settings() =
  assert settings(["mode", "level"], ["slow", "5"]) == ["slow", "5"]
  assert settings(["color"], ["red"]) == ["fast", "3", "red"]
  assert settings(["level", "mode"], ["5", "slow"]) == ["slow", "5"]
